#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""TEMP: export exact source-derived SW2-26 terminal closure projections.

This non-source-extension CI helper has no final acceptance authority.
Delete after generated documents are committed.
"""
import base64
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

def run(*args):
    p = subprocess.run(args, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)
    print("SW26_CLOSURE_GENERATOR_EXIT=" + str(p.returncode) + " COMMAND=" + " ".join(args[:3]))
    if p.returncode:
        print(p.stdout[-2500:])
    return p.returncode == 0

good = run(sys.executable, "scripts/sync_project_truth.py", "--root", ".", "--no-record")
good = run(sys.executable, "scripts/validate_documentation_contract.py", "--root", ".", "--write-report") and good
status = subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--porcelain", "-z", "--untracked-files=all"], text=True)
files = []
for entry in status.split("\0"):
    if len(entry) < 4:
        continue
    rel = entry[3:]
    path = Path(rel)
    if (rel.startswith("docs/") or rel == ".workflow/generated/documentation_coverage.json"
        or rel == ".workflow/generated/code_facts.json") and path.is_file():
        files.append(rel)
for rel in sorted(set(files)):
    data = Path(rel).read_bytes()
    encoded = base64.b64encode(data).decode("ascii")
    segments = [encoded[i:i+1200] for i in range(0, len(encoded), 1200)]
    print("SW26_CLOSURE_EXPORT|" + rel + "|" + str(len(data)) + "|" + str(len(segments)))
    for i, segment in enumerate(segments):
        print("SW26_CLOSURE_CHUNK|" + rel + "|" + str(i) + "|" + segment)
print("SW26_CLOSURE_EXPORT_COMPLETE=" + str(len(set(files))))
print("SW26_CLOSURE_GENERATION=" + ("PASS" if good else "FAIL"))
